name: Progress toast
summary: The presenter's import-progress notification: a fixed bottom-right card that tracks one background task from start to finish — file icon, name, bar, caption and its terminal states.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-progress-toast> — mirrors the presenter's ImportProgressNotification. It shows a leading file-type icon, the file name, a 5px progress bar and a caption row with an optional Cancel link. It updates in place through five states — progress, success, canceled, offline, error — by toggling attributes on persistent nodes, so the bar width animates (1.7s) instead of being recreated. The ✕ appears on success, canceled and error. A `footer` slot carries the inline cancel confirmation, the connection-lost buttons or the completion rating. The consumer owns the task, the copy and the timers (the presenter dismisses a successful card 2s after completion unless the rating is shown).
codeNote: Reach for <aha-progress-toast> for the slide Import notification. It is not a one-line confirmation (Toast), a titled message (Notification) or a blocking wait (Modal / Spin). Built values with no DS token (12.5px heading, #1F1330 ink, #6B6478 secondary, 5px bar, #D9D4E2 paused fill, #FF4081 Cancel hover, #D5493F error, #F2B8B5 hairline) are kept as built in the presenter, not rounded to DS values.

spec.label: Card

props.name: state
props.desc: Which of the five states the card shows

props.name: heading
props.desc: File name, or the headline "Import canceled" / "Connection lost" / "Import failed"

props.name: description
props.desc: Line under the heading: "{n}/{total} slides are now in your deck", "Waiting to reconnect…", "Something went wrong. Please try again."

props.name: caption
props.desc: Bottom-left text: "42%", "Importing slides…", "Almost done…" or "{count}/{total} slides imported"

props.name: dismiss-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the ✕ — pass the translated string

props.name: slot=footer
props.desc: Cancel confirmation, connection-lost buttons or the completion rating

props.name: dismiss
props.desc: Composed CustomEvent when the ✕ is pressed — the consumer removes the card

whenToUse.when: the slide Import notification — one background task the user keeps working beside
a one-line past-tense confirmation with nothing to track
a titled message with detail and at most one action, not a live task
the user must wait for or answer the task before continuing

opinion.note: One card per task, updated in place. The card has no timers: the consumer dismisses a successful card about 2s after completion (unless the rating is shown) and leaves canceled / offline / error until the user acts. Cancel with slides already created asks for confirmation in the footer ("Keep waiting" primary, "Cancel import" secondary); offline offers "Try again" and "Cancel import". Copy is verbatim from the presenter, including "Import canceled".
opinion.dsv3: Mirrors the presenter's ImportProgressNotification.vue, ImportCompletionCSAT.vue and FileTypeIcon.vue (stpancras-presenter-app PR #5833). Shadow is the DS Elevate/Overlays effect style. Rating is the DS <aha-csat>. No dedicated Figma component.
